Full Stack Developer

Contribute to LatexDo as a volunteer by building services and interfaces that make writing, reviewing, and publishing LaTeX documents easier.

About the volunteer role

We're looking for a volunteer Full Stack Developer to help build and improve LatexDo's open-source research tools. You'll contribute across backend services and the frontend, helping take features from an initial idea through implementation, testing, and release.

Languages

  • TypeScript
  • JavaScript
  • HTML
  • CSS

What you'll do

  • Design and implement backend services, APIs, and integrations for document workflows.
  • Connect frontend interfaces to backend features and handle loading, errors, and edge cases clearly.
  • Improve reliability, performance, and maintainability across the application.
  • Write tests, review changes, and document the features you ship.
  • Work with the team to turn user feedback into practical improvements.

What you'll bring

  • Experience building applications with TypeScript or JavaScript.
  • Confidence designing APIs, handling data, and debugging backend behavior.
  • Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and accessible frontend interfaces.
  • Comfort with Git, code reviews, and automated testing.
  • An interest in open-source software and tools for research and writing.
